title: Add horizontal pattern density control
decision: Add Pattern density next to Pattern scale as an independent continuous parameter. Density changes the dark-ink coverage from sparse to dense while scale continues to control feature size; 0.5 preserves the current threshold.
result: Added Pattern density from 0.1 to 0.9 with default 0.5. Focused schema/render assessment, protected browser/WebGL verification and embedded endpoint inspection passed; the preview was restored to density 0.5 and zoom 60%.
checks: Focused schema, product coverage and render-plan assessment
Protected iceberg.planePatternDensity browser and WebGL verification
Embedded Browser inspection at density 0.1 and 0.9
risks: Density endpoints must preserve recognizable black and white regions instead of collapsing to a solid plane.
